visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A handheld camera follows a young boy in a black hoodie as he approaches a large LEGO store entrance featuring the iconic red logo and a pixelated block wall. Shelves inside are densely packed with colorful LEGO boxed sets. (2) Inside the store, a young girl in a floral sweater joins the boy; they stand before a glass display containing a green LEGO dragon. The floor is a polished dark marble, and the lighting is bright and industrial. (3) The camera pans across shelves of Super Mario-themed LEGO sets, including a large Mario and Yoshi box. A hand reaches in to point at specific details on the packaging. (4) The scene shifts to a digital kiosk labeled 'Minifigure Factory'. A finger interacts with the touch screen, selecting a pink rabbit icon to place on a virtual yellow minifigure torso. (5) In a close-up, a girl's hand picks out tiny LEGO accessories from a clear plastic bin filled with varied parts. A man's hand then uses the screen to add '發' (prosperity) characters and a pineapple icon to a green-vested figure. (6) A detailed drawing of green mahjong tiles is created on the touch screen interface using a digital brush tool. (7) The camera captures the internal mechanism of a printer as it moves back and forth, depositing ink onto several white LEGO torso pieces arranged on a yellow tray. (8) A completed custom minifigure is held up: it wears a pink bear headpiece, glasses, and the green vest designed earlier. A small lute-like instrument is placed in its hand. (9) Another minifigure is shown with '高雄 台北' text on its back as the boy smiles in the background. (10) The custom bear minifigure is placed inside a specialized cardboard display box that unfolds to reveal an interior workshop scene with gears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, major-key acoustic pop BGM begins with a clear rhythmic pulse. An adult male voice welcomes the audience with a bright, energetic tone, accompanied by the muffled sounds of a public retail space. (2) Two distinct high-pitched children's voices join the conversation, expressing curiosity and excitement through animated inflections. Faint sounds of plastic bricks rustling are heard during speech pauses. (3) The BGM volume ducks slightly as the adult male provides detailed commentary on store items. Short, mechanical 'click' sound effects punctuate the audio as selections are made on a digital interface. (4) Laughter and playful banter between the three voices occur over a consistent musical bed. A digital 'ding' sound effect confirms a successful action in the shop's application. (5) The mechanical whirring of a printer becomes audible in the mix, followed by the father's enthusiastic exclamation at seeing the final physical product, concluding with a warm, satisfied vocal tone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Exploration -> Customization Process -> Reveal
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a family's interactive shopping experience at a LEGO store, specifically demonstrating the unique custom minifigure creation service available at the Kaohsiung location.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video provides an in-depth walkthrough of LEGO's custom manufacturing service and showcases the branded store environment in a positive, experiential manner.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines child-focused exploration with a detailed showcase of a niche brand service, using high-paced editing and subtitles to maintain viewer interest throughout the tutorial-style sequence.
